# Renan Marçal

> Product Designer with 6 years of experience in fintech and B2B, specialized in design systems, discovery, and complex platform design. Based in São Paulo, Brazil. Available for full-time roles and consulting.

Portfolio available in Portuguese (default), English, and Spanish.

## Case studies

- [C6 Pay merchant portal](https://renanmarcal.com/cases/case-portal-b2b-c6-bank.html): Redesign of the B2B management portal for merchants in the C6 Pay ecosystem at C6 Bank. Also available in [EN](https://renanmarcal.com/en/cases/case-portal-b2b-c6-bank.html) and [ES](https://renanmarcal.com/es/cases/case-portal-b2b-c6-bank.html).
- [Sales visit prioritization](https://renanmarcal.com/cases/case-priorizacao-visitas-comerciais-mercado-pago.html): Redesign of the field sales visit prioritization flow for Mercado Pago's internal CRM, covering Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina. Also available in [EN](https://renanmarcal.com/en/cases/case-priorizacao-visitas-comerciais-mercado-pago.html) and [ES](https://renanmarcal.com/es/cases/case-priorizacao-visitas-comerciais-mercado-pago.html).
- [Landing pages at scale](https://renanmarcal.com/cases/case-landing-pages-checkout-mercado-pago.html): Component system and creative automation for Mercado Pago's landing pages across seven Latin American markets. Portuguese only.
